player_prompt.intro:
Ngeye Mukishi {player_id} mu kijogo cha Indian Poker.
- Kikasha cha makadi 52; ngeye kuwana kadi ya mukwenu.
- Kukolaya malonda {ante} kwa kila kipindi, {max_rounds} kipindi kwa jumla.
- Mijogo ya kufwete: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X ni nambari nzuri <= kiwango chako cha malonda.)
- Kadi ya kufichika inayofwete kubeta kipindi cha kuzemba.

invalid_move.ambiguous: Pese kiakulu kimosi kya kuakisa, kima ki: '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', kana '[fold]'.
invalid_move.cannot_check: Kikulayi ku [check] - ngeye kuwana kipindi cha malonda.
invalid_move.amount_min: O kitadi kia tokala ku ki bandekesa, a tokala ku i ta mu 1.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Se ki bhuala kima, u tena ku [check] sota mu kididi kiki.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Bhanga [bet X] phala ku jikula o kijimbuete; kana kuta dingi kitadi.
invalid_move.insufficient: O athu ka kexile ni kitadi kiavulu phala ku sumba o ima íii.

board.possible_actions: O ima i u tena kubhanga: {legal}

message.round_result: {reason}  Kipindi cha malonda {pot} → Mukishi {winner}. (Kukolaya kwa P0:{p0}, P1:{p1})
message.showdown_tie: Kipindi cha kusokana: zote mbili {card}. Kipindi kya malonda – kila muntu akwata {split}.

outcome.draw: O jimbandu joso ja jokala, ki ji lunguluka.
